title: Dak Prescott: "Super honored" to set Cowboys TD record, want to double it

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dak Prescott: "Super honored" to set Cowboys TD record, want to double it
sources.description: Dak Prescott owned most of the career quarterbacking records for the Cowboys before Sunday's game against the Commanders kicked off and he broke one of the other ones late in the fourth quarter.
